searchText: Week 2 Dev updates | June 17-23 Hey <@686695036733227017>, I see you have given Fellowship roles to those who have got selected as permissioned fellows, but when you are tagging Fellowship, only those with role gets notified. is there a way you can make another role or anything else, those who are participating permissionlessly can get notified too? yup, that would be amazing <@&857649635274915900> Join our first weekly standup starting <t:1718636400:R> at https://meet.ethquokkaops.io/epf-standup I get a notif even though I'm participating permissionless-ly Hey <@686695036733227017>, where can I find the schedule for the EPF event in Brussels? I have flights to Brussels and I'm here as a permissionless participant, so I want to go to the event. https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/1250134978122092564 The event is on Sunday 7th, we will release more details soon I don't have access :b We have a kind of accommodation for that day? I have flights and reservations starting from July 8th. I think I can move the flights and pay the airline penalty, but the accommodation was provided by a hacker house. Europe is very expensive 😢 Starting now!
